Key says 'keep the default replication behavior, where a delete adds a delete marker in the source only'. The DR whitepaper says this, but the S3 replication docs (replication-what-is-isnot-replicated) say the default depends on configuration version: with the current configuration (Filter element) delete markers are not replicated by default, but without a Filter element (V1) S3 replicates delete markers from user actions. The stem does not say which, so 'default' is ambiguous and the two AWS pages differ (candidate for content/contradictions.json).
Deleting a specific version ID is not replicated in either case, which is the stronger 'protects from malicious deletion' fact.
